user.title: Connect Tessie Drive Stats
user.description: Enter a Tessie access token and Tesla VIN. The vehicle name will be fetched automatically from Tessie and used for the Home Assistant device and entity names.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Tessie
reauth_confirm.description: The Tessie access token was rejected. Enter a new access token.

error.invalid_vin: That VIN is not available to this Tessie access token.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The reauthentication response did not match this vehicle.

init.title: Tessie Drive Stats options
init.description: Choose how often current/core history is refreshed and which day starts your week. Heavier history and health endpoints refresh less frequently automatically.
